assets.name: integrated_panel
assets.prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. Asset type: production transparent Unity UI sprite. Edit target is the attached gold panel frame. Preserve the four small diamond corners and clean warm-gold beveled straight border style. Create a COMPLETE PANEL: fill the entire enclosed interior with one uniform fully opaque very dark burgundy #130f15. Exterior outside the exact gold outline MUST be fully transparent alpha, no rectangular backdrop protruding beyond corners. Simplify and clean every exterior edge: remove ALL dust, specks, detached pixels, drop shadows, glows and wispy outlines. Gold rails have uniform weight and perfectly horizontal/vertical edges. No extra ornaments, no crest, no text. Keep square composition and 4 diamond corners, frame nearly fills canvas with transparent outer margin. Interior must be totally opaque and flat, ideal for nine-slice stretching. Crisp game UI production art.

assets.name: integrated_bubble
assets.prompt: Use case: ui-mockup. Asset type: production transparent Unity dialogue bubble SPRITE, no text. Use attached gold frame only as STYLE REFERENCE. Create ONE wide rectangular complete speech panel, width about three times its height. Thin clean warm-gold beveled border with four small gold diamond corner rivets, fully opaque flat very dark burgundy #130f15 interior. On LEFT edge exactly at vertical midpoint: a small triangular speech pointer pointing LEFT, seamlessly part of the same enclosed silhouette; remove the vertical border across the mouth of the triangle so the inside stays connected. Triangle gold outline must be exactly the SAME thickness and same bevel as the straight border, no doubled line. Right edge straight. Left pointer depth about 5% of panel width, total base height 25% of panel height. Uniform border width about 2.5% of panel height. Exterior fully TRANSPARENT alpha, absolutely no drop shadow, glow, fuzz, dust, stray pixels, rectangular backing, extra ornaments, crest, icons or text. Maintain a perfectly flat solid interior suitable for Unity sliced mesh. Crisp production UI, not a screenshot.
